# CANDIDATE: VWAP_BAND_MEAN_REVERSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

During low volatility, a large negative deviation from VWAP paired with a bullish close predicts a mean‑reversion move back to VWAP. The edge exists because volatility compression often precedes mean-reverts to a reversion toward fair value (VWAP), and a strong bullish close after a deviation indicates buying pressure that can catalyze the reversion.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If ATR(5) < 0.5 * ATR(20) (volatility compression) AND price < VWAP - 1.5*ATR(10) AND current candle close > open AND (close - low) > 0.7 * (high - low) (strong bullish close) THEN enter long at the candle close. Exit shape: Stop at entry - ATR(5); first target at 1.5R to VWAP; trail remainder with a chandelier exit (ATR*2) after 0.75R is reached. Regime hint: Most effective during midday (11:30‑13:30 EST) when volatility tends to contract; avoid the first and last 30 minutes of the session and extreme VIX (<12 or >30).
